acceptance_oracle: For APPLY_MOCK terminal records, emit the ATS provider only when resolved from the persisted application-to-route relationship and recognized by the existing ATS provider registry. Provider lookup is best effort after durable terminal-state persistence; missing, unknown, malformed, or unavailable context is omitted without changing the operation outcome. Never serialize operation params, application content, credentials, URLs, or exception diagnostics.
implementation: Resolve application_routes.provider through the persisted applications.route_id relation after the worker terminal-state transaction commits.
Catch provider lookup failures as optional log-enrichment failures; preserve the already-persisted operation result.
Allow only providers in KNOWN_ATS_PROVIDERS plus mock-ats, and emit the accepted value in the JSON ats field for APPLY_MOCK only.

Unit and worker lifecycle tests cover provider allowlisting, malformed and secret-shaped values, non-APPLY_MOCK omission, private parameter exclusion, terminal persistence before log emission, and lookup failure isolation.
